cases.obligation: The 64-entry macOS overlay queue reserves terminal capacity from accepted start through end while allowing saturated point and label work to degrade without blocking.
Coalesced overlay wakeups cannot strand accepted work when enqueue races the pending-wake transition.
The macOS overlay starts without native resources or a main-thread readiness acknowledgement and creates native state only after an accepted start.
The native overlay window policy is transparent, click-through, nonactivating, and available on all Spaces including full-screen auxiliary presentation.
The macOS trail applies pinned color and thickness in point order while retaining at most 64 visual points.

The pinned action label preserves family and size, maps configured weight to bounded native steps, uses a bounded surface at the latest accepted trail point, and hides when no action label is present.
A changed screen-frame signature is detected and clears the retained trail before later visual work.
Overlay end makes native visual state inactive, clears retained trail points, and releases the owned label state.
A renderer failure preserves exactly one replay for a suppressed trigger through prepare and finish shutdown while later physical input passes through.
A Tauri main-thread exit request delegates bounded worker and overlay shutdown without synchronously waiting on its own main-thread drain.
